answer: The horizon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mirror is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
